reapack.name: MPE Editor
reapack.desc: MPE Editor - Per-note MPE expression curve editor for REAPER

version.author: externalmethod0
version.changelog:
MPE Editor 1.1.2 Release
New & Improved: - Normal Mouse Wheel Zoom: Bare mouse wheel scrolls to zoom horizontally without holding Ctrl (Ctrl+Wheel scrolls vertically). Fully configurable via action and API, persists across sessions. - Reset All Expressions: Standalone action "MPE Editor: Reset all expression curves for selected notes" and canvas shortcut Shift+F to simultaneously clear Pitch Bend, Pressure, and Timbre CC74 curves with complete Undo history. - Instant Grid Division & Swing Reaction: Canvas dynamically listens to REAPER's grid settings and instantly redraws grid divisions and swing alignment. - Inline Editor Mode: Compact strip attached directly to arrange view items with auto-zoom and 6 modulation brushes. - Host Theme & Docker Integration: Notes inherit item/track colors; curves adapt to light/dark themes; middle-click dock closing supported. - Real-time playhead sync with arrange view & note audition on click.
Install note: REAPER only loads extensions at startup, so restart REAPER after installing or updating.
